evidence.sourceTitle: Canva raises USD 200 million at a USD 40 billion valuation
evidence.shortExcerpt: News coverage before the measurement date reported Canva's funding amount, valuation, user scale and enterprise adoption.

observedFacts.statement: News coverage described Canva as having a team of about 2,000 people.
News coverage listed Salesforce, Marriott International, PayPal and American Airlines as Canva enterprise customers.
News coverage reported more than 500,000 teams paying for Canva.

evidence.shortExcerpt: Canva announced a USD 200m funding round, USD 40bn valuation, more than 60m monthly users and positive free cash flow.

observedFacts.statement: Canva announced a USD 200 million funding round on 2021-09-15.
Canva announced a USD 40 billion headline valuation after the funding round.
Canva reported generating positive free cash flow at the time of the September 2021 announcement.
Canva reported more than 60 million monthly active users at the time of the funding announcement.
observedFacts.unit: millions monthly active users, greater than

observedFacts.statement: Canva reported users in 190 countries at the time of the funding announcement.

evidence.shortExcerpt: ABN Lookup identifies Canva Pty Ltd as an active Australian private company with ABN and ACN metadata.

observedFacts.statement: ABN Lookup identifies the entity name as CANVA PTY LTD.
ABN Lookup links Canva Pty Ltd to ACN 158 929 938.
ABN Lookup records ABN 80 158 929 938 as active from 2012-06-12.
